# Coverage by language

Each page lists what CrossTL translates to and from one language, measured on commit [`35ed8c7`](https://github.com/CrossGL/crosstl/commit/35ed8c7dc43264b625206cb6bf60d0858d205616) at 2026-11-24T12:11:45Z (CrossTL 3.8.0). CI probes every feature of a pinned upstream feature list, checks each translation with the language's reference compiler or validator and, where it has a runtime for the language, runs it. [COVERAGE.md](../COVERAGE.md) has the same numbers for every language on one page.
